name: isitlegit-media
description: IsItLegit channel videos in Remotion. Its own pnpm root (media/pnpm-workspace.yaml), outside the root workspace.

scripts.studio: pnpm run stats && pnpm run voice && pnpm run capture:index && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:01: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run stats && pnpm run check:facts && pnpm run voice && pnpm run capture:index && remotion render src/index.ts DevProcess out2/raw/01-how-isitlegit-is-built.mp4 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=536870912 && python3 tools/master.py out2/raw/01-how-isitlegit-is-built.mp4 out2/01-how-isitlegit-is-built.mp4
scripts.render:02: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run stats && pnpm run check:facts && pnpm run voice && pnpm run capture:index && remotion render src/index.ts TechDeepDive out2/raw/02-isitlegit-technical-deep-dive.mp4 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=536870912 && python3 tools/master.py out2/raw/02-isitlegit-technical-deep-dive.mp4 out2/02-isitlegit-technical-deep-dive.mp4
scripts.render:03: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run stats && pnpm run check:facts && pnpm run voice && pnpm run capture:index && remotion render src/index.ts LoupeV1 out2/raw/03-loupe-1-0.mp4 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=536870912 && python3 tools/master.py out2/raw/03-loupe-1-0.mp4 out2/03-loupe-1-0.mp4
scripts.render:04: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run stats && pnpm run capture:index && python3 tools/voice-index.py 04 demo && remotion render src/index.ts JudgeGuide out2/raw/04-judge-getting-started.mp4 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=536870912 && python3 tools/master.py out2/raw/04-judge-getting-started.mp4 out2/04-judge-getting-started.mp4
scripts.render:teaser: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run stats && pnpm run capture:index && python3 tools/voice-index.py demo && remotion render src/index.ts XTeaser out2/raw/x-teaser-45s.mp4 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=536870912 && python3 tools/master.py out2/raw/x-teaser-45s.mp4 out2/x-teaser-45s.mp4
scripts.render:logo: pnpm run stats && pnpm run voice && pnpm run capture:index && remotion render src/index.ts LogoReveal out2/isitlegit-logo-animation-1080p.mp4
scripts.thumbs: pnpm run stats && pnpm run voice && pnpm run capture:index && for v in 01 02 03; do remotion still src/index.ts Thumbnail$v out/thumbnail-$v.jpg --frame=45 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90; done
scripts.render:demo: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run stats && pnpm run check:pdf-facts && pnpm run capture:index && python3 tools/voice-index.py demo && remotion render src/index.ts Demo out2/raw/demo-final.mp4 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=536870912 && python3 tools/master.py out2/raw/demo-final.mp4 out2/demo-final.mp4
scripts.still:demo: pnpm run capture:index && remotion still src/index.ts Demo
scripts.render:banner: pnpm run stats && pnpm run capture:index && python3 tools/voice-index.py demo && remotion still src/index.ts ChannelBanner out2/youtube-banner-derickpaynedev.png --frame=0 --image-format=png
